dimensions.note: The 국회예산정책처 report listing page (경제전망 및 정책분석 section) surfaces only report titles, issue dates, and download-file indicators — e.g. '2026년 NABO 경제전망: 2025~2029', described in a press summary as organizing analysis into 4개 부문 (지출·생산·소득·지속성장). This four-part structure is a genuine, checkable content-type-fit signal for a fiscal/economic outlook report (expenditure/output/income/sustainability as parallel analytical lenses), but it comes from a secondary press description of the report's stated scope, not from reading the report's own body prose.
dimensions.evidence: Secondary summary: report divides analysis into '지출·생산·소득·지속성장 등 4개 부문' — structure claim only, not sentence-level.

dimensions.note: Could not verify. The report body is distributed as a PDF; the NABO report listing and detail pages fetched for this record contained only titles, dates, and file-download affordances, no extractable body prose. No sentence-level claim is made about NABO's Korean craft.

strengths: Stated four-part analytical framing (지출·생산·소득·지속성장) for a multi-year economic outlook is a legitimate content-type-fit data point for report-genre structure, corroborating a segmented-by-analytical-lens approach at a second budget/fiscal institution distinct from BOK's situation-then-issue template.
weaknesses: No sentence-level prose (hedging language, sentence length, clause construction, terminology rendering) was verified for this record; the source is PDF-gated and this evaluation did not extract its text. This record must not be read as evidence about NABO's actual writing craft, only about its stated report scope.
